name: scenario_0782
description: The user is conducting a literature review and wants to organize follow-ups with the corresponding authors of recent scientific papers (published after 2010) to request additional materials. (UI mode)

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: I'm organizing my literature review. Please look at these papers and pull up their publication details — I need to decide which ones to add corresponding authors for in my contacts.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to review the three provided scientific papers and present their titles and publication years. When the assistant presents the papers with their details, select only the ones published after 2010 and ask to add their corresponding authors to your contacts with email addresses via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add contacts for the papers published after 2010. If the assistant asks for confirmation or completes the task, acknowledge it and move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Here are three more papers. Actually, I changed my mind about adding authors to my phone contacts—it'll get too cluttered. Please delete the contacts you just created. Instead, let's track this in Todoist. Create a project called 'Literature Review' and add a task to email the corresponding author for EVERY paper published after 2010 from all six images. Include their name and email in the task description.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind about adding the authors to your contacts and ask it to delete the contacts it just created. Then, ask it to create a new Todoist project called 'Literature Review'. Instruct the assistant to review the three new papers along with the previous three, and for every paper published after 2010, create a task in the new project to email the corresponding author. Emphasize that the task description should include the author's name and email. If the assistant misses any papers or asks for clarification, point it back to the images to check the publication years. Once confirmed, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: Create a new label called 'reprint_request' in Todoist and add it to all the tasks you just created in that project.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new label called 'reprint_request' in Todoist and apply it to all the tasks it just created in the 'Literature Review' project. If the assistant needs help finding the tasks, remind it they are in the project you just created. Once the label is applied to all relevant tasks, move on to the next round.

ROUND 4
Query: I want to get a head start on one of them. Send an email to the author of the lung carcinoma paper asking for a copy of their supplementary data.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to send an email to the corresponding author of the lung carcinoma paper from the provided images, asking for a copy of their supplementary data. If the assistant asks which paper or author you mean, remind it to check the titles of the papers provided earlier. Once the email is sent, you can end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3,4,5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

Thank you,
Cheryl Martinez
